recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. FHIR-32763 is correctly satisfied by the existing FHIR-20770 application in current build-scope source, and no R4 technical correction belongs in the current specification branch.
issue_request: FHIR-32763 was Applied/Persuasive and asked to add CodeableConcept as a CommunicationRequest.payload.content[x] choice because jurisdictions identify standard documents in communication requests by codes such as LOINC. Its final resolution marked it as a duplicate of FHIR-20770 and stated that no R4 technical correction was warranted because the change had already been applied in R5 through FHIR-20770.
initial_application: There was no separate FHIR-32763 source application. GF#20770 commits f7c3c1d and 8b4d465 had already added CodeableConcept to CommunicationRequest.payload.content, removed string, updated comments, and changed the example from contentString to contentCodeableConcept.text.
additional_context: FHIR-20770 is Published/Persuasive and explicitly resolved to add CodeableConcept to both Communication.payload.content and CommunicationRequest.payload.content with the comment explaining that contentCodeableConcept is the communicated content. Patient Care Confluence minutes on 2023-08-17 and 2023-08-24 list FHIR-32763 as a duplicate of FHIR-20770. source/fhir.ini includes communicationrequest as an active resource.
